institution: The University of Tennessee Health Science Center

app_fee.value: The UTHSC College of Graduate Health Sciences charges no application fee.
app_fee.quote: Students may apply online. There is no application fee.

fee_waiver.value: No application fee waiver is needed because College of Graduate Health Sciences programs have no application fee.
fee_waiver.quote: Students may apply online. There is no application fee.

gre_general.value: College of Graduate Health Sciences baseline requires a revised GRE combined verbal + quantitative score of at least 300, though individual PhD programs waive or make the GRE optional (see program entries).
gre_general.quote: Admission as a regular student requires a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent with an undergraduate grade point average (GPA) of at least 3.0 (on a 4.0 scale) from an accredited college or university and a revised Graduate Record Examinations (GRE) combined score totaling at least 300 for verbal and quantitative sections.

toefl_min.value: The College of Graduate Health Sciences requires a minimum TOEFL iBT score of 79.
toefl_min.quote: The College of Graduate Health Sciences requires an Internet-Based exam TOEFL score of 79.

also.quote: a score of at least 213/79 on the computer-based/Internet-based TOEFL or 6.5 on the IELTS

ielts_min.value: The College of Graduate Health Sciences requires an IELTS score of at least 6.5 (alternative to TOEFL 79).
ielts_min.quote: a score of at least 213/79 on the computer-based/Internet-based TOEFL or 6.5 on the IELTS

english_waiver.value: Exemption applies only to applicants whose first language is not English who earned a bachelor's or master's degree in the United States, Canada, Great Britain, or Australia (English-speaking countries); degrees from India are not exempt.
english_waiver.quote: Any applicant whose first language is not English and who has earned neither a bachelor’s nor a master’s degree from a college or university in the United States, Canada, Great Britain, or Australia must have achieved a TOEFL score of at least 79 (earned within 2 years prior to application) to be admitted. Any applicant whose first language is not English but who has earned a baccalaureate or master’s degree from a college or university in the United States, Canada, Great Britain, or Australia, may be exempted from the requirement for the TOEFL.

notes: UTHSC health-science campus. Only PhD programs in STEM health-science scope are Biomedical Sciences (including the Neuroscience concentration) and the Joint Program in Biomedical Engineering with the University of Memphis.
